text:
```yaml
name: Cargo Vet Auto Regeneration

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - Cargo.lock
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize

jobs:
  cargo-vet-auto-regen:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Run cargo vet regenerate exemptions
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-vet
          cargo vet regenerate exemptions --yes

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add Cargo.toml Cargo.lock
          git commit -m "Auto-regenerate cargo-vet exemptions"
          git push origin ${{ github.ref }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Re-run CI checks
        if: always()
        run: echo "::set-output name=needs_recheck::true"
```
